canonical_books.title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs (SICP)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute. Computational processes as abstract entities manipulating abstract data.

canonical_books.title: The C Programming Language
canonical_books.core_axiom: Direct control of hardware, explicit memory management, structured programming, and unambiguous semantics.

canonical_books.title: Think Python
canonical_books.core_axiom: Computational thinking and problem decomposition from first principles.

canonical_books.title: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Rigorous asymptotic analysis (Big-O, Omega, Theta), dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and graph theory.

canonical_books.title: The Algorithm Design Manual
canonical_books.core_axiom: War stories and practical algorithm design: modeling problems into known graph/combinatorial structures.

canonical_books.title: The Art of Computer Programming (TAOCP)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Mathematical precision, exact step analysis, combinatorial algorithms, and fundamental algorithms.

canonical_books.title: Clean Code
canonical_books.core_axiom: Small atomic functions, single responsibility, meaningful naming, and leaving the code cleaner than you found it (Boy Scout Rule).

canonical_books.title: Refactoring
canonical_books.core_axiom: Transforming the internal structure of software to make it easier to understand and cheaper to modify without changing its observable behavior.

canonical_books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
canonical_books.core_axiom: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), Orthogonality, Tracer Bullets, Broken Windows Theory, and continuous learning.

canonical_books.title: Working Effectively with Legacy Code
canonical_books.core_axiom: Legacy code is code without tests. Finding seams, breaking dependencies, and introducing characterization tests.

canonical_books.title: Code Complete
canonical_books.core_axiom: Exhaustive software construction, defensive programming, and engineering discipline across the full construction lifecycle.

canonical_books.title: Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Ubiquitous Language, Bounded Contexts, Aggregates, Entities, Value Objects, and Domain Events as the true core of complex software.

canonical_books.title: Design Patterns (GoF)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Reusable object-oriented design patterns: Creational, Structural, and Behavioral abstractions.

canonical_books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications (DDIA)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Reliability, Scalability, Maintainability. LSM-Trees vs B-Trees, Consensus (Raft/Paxos), Linearizability, Event Streams, and Partitioning.

canonical_books.title: Software Architecture: The Hard Parts
canonical_books.core_axiom: Architecture is the stuff that's hard to change. Evaluating trade-offs in distributed transactions (Sagas), service granularity, and data isolation.

canonical_books.title: Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture
canonical_books.core_axiom: Domain Model, Data Mapper, Unit of Work, Repository, and Service Layer patterns.

domains.domain: SISTEMAS OPERATIVOS, REDES Y BAJO NIVEL

canonical_books.title: Computer Systems: A Programmer's Perspective (CS:APP)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Understanding how the CPU, cache hierarchy (L1/L2/L3), memory virtualizer, and linker collaborate to execute code.

canonical_books.title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces (OSTEP)
canonical_books.core_axiom: The three pillars: Virtualization (CPU/Memory), Concurrency (Threads/Locks/Semaphores), and Persistence (File Systems/Disks).

canonical_books.title: Computer Networking: A Top-Down Approach
canonical_books.core_axiom: Application layer down to physical: HTTP, DNS, TCP congestion control, sliding windows, IP routing, and packet mechanics.

canonical_books.title: You Don't Know JS Yet (YDKJS)
canonical_books.core_axiom: Scope, Closures, this & Object Prototypes, Types & Grammar, Async & Performance, and the JavaScript Event Loop.

canonical_books.title: Eloquent JavaScript
canonical_books.core_axiom: From functional programming and data structures to asynchronous programming and browser DOM manipulation.

canonical_books.title: Database System Concepts
canonical_books.core_axiom: Relational algebra, normalization (1NF-BCNF), ACID transaction management, indexing, and query optimization.

canonical_books.title: SQL Antipatterns
canonical_books.core_axiom: Identifying and avoiding structural, query, and architectural pitfalls in relational database design.
